shots.focal_element: Feature headline centred between the two lens openings of the headset interior
shots.typography: Clean geometric sans, semibold, title case, normal tracking, white, single centred line (low-confidence guess: Meta's Optimistic Display-like face)
shots.what_happens: A symmetric render of the headset's inside, looking out through the two lenses at a soft pastel sky, holds while the feature label sits centred; by the last sampled frame the view has already changed to the game character with the next caption mid-reveal.
shots.build_rebuild: Place a dark headset-interior render full-bleed, overlay a centred white semibold title-case label, and hold it for about 1 s before cutting to the in-headset content.

shots.focal_element: A CG armoured game character with a sword on his shoulder, caption across his chest
shots.typography: Same sans as the feature labels, semibold, sentence case, normal tracking, white over the scene; words reveal separately ("Clearer" and "sharper" visible first, spread apart, then the line closes up)
shots.what_happens: Game footage of the character under a blue sky; the caption builds word by word with the words drifting into a single centred line, then the shot ends on a pastel gradient frame that belongs to the next title card.
shots.build_rebuild: Over a full-bleed game clip, stagger in each caption word (about 0.1 s apart) from spread-out positions so they converge into one centred line, then hard cut to a pastel gradient.

shots.focal_element: Centred kinetic headline on a soft pastel gradient
on_screen_text: VR is about to get even more real
shots.typography: Geometric sans, semibold to bold, sentence case, dark text; first line medium size, second line larger and heavier; normal tracking
shots.what_happens: The line "VR is about to get even more real" holds, then its words wave and lift with motion blur ("even" pops up highest) before swapping to a larger "A lot more real"; the last sampled frame already shows the white headset front, coinciding with the speech words "go ahead" (w10-w11) near the shot's start.
shots.build_rebuild: On a pastel diagonal gradient, set a centred dark semibold line, animate its words out with a staggered upward wave plus motion blur, and replace it with a larger bold follow-up line held for about 1.5 s.

shots.focal_element: Front of the white Quest 3 headset with its three vertical sensor pills and logo
shots.what_happens: A brief (0.42 s) frontal hero render of the headset fills the frame against a light gradient.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a centred, frame-filling front product render on a pale gradient and hold for about 10 frames as a beat-length punctuation.

shots.focal_element: Words emerging from a blue tunnel formed by the headset's centre sensor pill
shots.typography: Geometric sans, semibold, title case, white, normal tracking; "Breakthrough" arrives slightly tilted with blur and leaves with a horizontal smear/glitch, "Meta Reality" holds steady
shots.what_happens: The camera pushes into the headset's centre sensor pill, which becomes a glowing blue rounded-rectangle tunnel; "Breakthrough" flies out of it onto a dark blue-green gradient, smears away horizontally and is replaced by "Meta Reality"; the final sampled frame is already a live-action living-room scene.
shots.build_rebuild: Scale the product render toward the centre pill until it fills the frame, morph it into a blurred glowing tunnel, fly a tilted title out of the tunnel and settle it, then swap it with a horizontal smear-blur to a second title on a dark gradient.

shots.focal_element: A young man on a green sofa handling the headset in a sunlit living room
shots.what_happens: Warm live-action lifestyle shot: the man sits on the sofa holding the headset, with a table blurred in the foreground and window light flaring behind; only one frame is sampled so any motion is not visible.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a short warm-graded wide lifestyle clip with the subject on the right third, an out-of-focus foreground surface and backlit windows on the left.
